docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,010.00 FILED BY DEZA, RICHARD P. AS TO DEFENDANT SOTO, JEOVANNA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-06-2009 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED JAN-01-2009, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT SOTO, JEOVANNA
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-06-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DEZA, RICHARD P. IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SOTO, JEOVANNA THE COURT DETERMINES THAT ANY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR BREACH OF AN ORAL AGREEMENT IS BARRED BY THE STATUTE OF LIMITAIONS. SUBMITTING, ANY CLAIM FOR INDEMNIFICATION FOR PLAINTIFF'S EXPENDITURE OF $3,010 IS BARRED BY PLAINTIFF'S UNDUE DELAY IN BRINGING ACTION TO COLLECT.
